verdict.rationale: The evidence gives only indirect support. Self-hosted containers can resolve environment variables in served pages (fern-docs-11, fern-docs-31), and versions can share content (fern-docs-13), but neither is a writer-facing feature for reusing snippets across pages. missing for 10: a documented reusable snippet/partial include feature, author-defined content variables usable across pages in hosted docs, examples of keeping repeated content in sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.
